title: Shopping List to Inventory Transfer Workflow & Bought Product Synchronization
acceptance_criteria: Implement backend endpoint POST /api/v1/households/{id}/shopping-list/transfer-to-inventory that atomically transfers purchased shopping list items into PostgreSQL InventoryItems for the household.

Smart storage location and shelf life defaults are automatically assigned based on product category/name (e.g. dairy/meat -> Fridge +4 days, grains/canned -> Pantry +90 days, frozen -> Freezer +180 days).
Transferred items are removed from shopping_list_items or marked completed in the same database transaction.

ShoppingListView renders an active 'Перенести куплені в інвентар (N)' button when purchased items exist, with a quick review modal allowing the user to confirm/adjust storage location and expiry before transfer.
Toggling an item to purchased displays an instant inline prompt or toast allowing 1-click immediate transfer to inventory.
Add integration tests in Ediens.Tests verifying that transfer creates real rows in inventory_items, removes rows from shopping_list_items, and responds with 403 when user is not a household member.
